call_points.text: Q1FY27 was the lowest quarter; sequential improvement expected in Q2FY27 and YoY growth from H2FY27.
FY27 margin should be closer to the previous year's percentage, with acceleration from FY28.
Restocking order for one destocked molecule secured, with deliveries spread over two years into Q4FY27 and FY28.
Gross margin fell to 71.5% from 73% on product mix and higher freight and raw material costs.
Consolidated net cash of ₹251.2 Cr as of 30 June 2026.
USFDA inspection of Pashamylaram ended with a Form 483 with five observations, none on data integrity.
NJ Bio's cost base is high relative to revenue after losing FTE customers to biotech funding concerns.
CFO Himanshu Agarwal remains in his role until 13 September 2026; succession update to follow.
Capex spend in FY26 was ₹2.15 billion, and expected to be nearly ₹3 billion in FY27.
FY27 is expected to be a growth year weighted to 2H, with Q1FY27 being the low point for revenue and EBITDA.
Deployed ₹215.4 Cr capex in FY26 across Oligo Nacharam expansion, Suryapet capacity and high-containment upgradation.
Gross margins improved 209 bps YoY to 70.8% in FY26 supported by product mix and subsidiary consolidation.
Nacharam regulatory remediation disruption caused a ₹61 Cr impact in FY26, with another quarter needed for normalisation.
Niche technology share rose to 16.2% of revenues in FY26 and 18.8% in Q4FY26.

operating_notes.text: Q4 FY26 revenue from operations stood at ₹619.12 Cr with an EBITDA of ₹98.68 Cr.
Total impact of regulatory disruption at Nacharam plant in FY26 stood at ₹61 Cr.
Niche technology share contributed 16.2% of revenues in FY26 and 18.8% in Q4FY26.
FY26 revenue stood at ₹2,268 Cr with EBITDA margin of 21%.
Commercial versus development mix in Pharma CDMO was 57%:43% in Q1FY27, with commercial OTIF at 100% year-to-date.
API+ was about 60% of segment mix in Q1FY27, concentrated in CNS and controlled substances, with products where Cohance holds more than 50% of global market share with innovators.
Two molecules are expected to face patent expiration, but the intermediates supplied are for post-patent expiration and the decline has already been seen over the past two fiscal years.
